name: Witch’s Lewd Curse
storyline: Witch’s Lewd Curse is an adult, explicit visual novel set in a mystical realm brimming with intrigue, romance, and monster girls. You play as an ordinary man who’s been cursed by the powerful Witch, Velina, forcing you to collect lewd energy in order to break free. To lift the soul-binding spell, you’ll explore diverse regions, build intimate bonds, and indulge in sensual encounters with an array of bewitching monster girls—all while trying to uncover Velina’s hidden motives.
